title: Hölder inequality for the uniform inner product
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $p,q\in\mathbb R$ be Hölder conjugates, and let $f,g:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. Then the uniform inner product satisfies $\langle f,g\rangle_u\leq \|f\|_{p,u}\,\|g\|_{q,u}$, where the uniform $r$-norm is the uniform expectation of $|h|^r$ raised to the power $1/r$.
